headline: EPS falls sequentially but tops last year
summary_short: TKC reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥76.12, up 24.9% y/y from ¥60.95.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥76.12 rose 24.9% year-over-year from ¥60.95, but fell 34.0% sequentially from ¥115.34 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
